moodys.description: Developing and maintaining full-stack applications that are widely used throughout Moody's Ratings, leveraging Java (Spring Boot) and PostreSQL for scalable backend solutions, along with GraphQL for efficient data fetching. On the frontend, building dynamic and responsive user interfaces using Angular and TypeScript. Collaborating on teams within an Agile/SCRUM environment to deliver high-quality, maintainable software, while actively participating in code reviews, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

slalom.description: Contributed to the re-platforming of Slalom Build's internal contacts application by integrating key features into the organization's central platform. Developed back-end services using Node.js and built interactive frontend components with Angular and TypeScript. Worked in an Agile/SCRUM environment to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions while gaining hands-on experience in full-stack development.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: Earned the AWS Cloud Practitioner certification by demonstrating strong foundational knowledge of AWS services, cloud concepts, security, and best practices. Earned during time at internship at Slalom Build.

projects.dkmsDescription: Developed DKMS, a web application designed to enhance the core Spotify experience by integrating analytics, song playback, personalized music recommendations, and social networking features. Built using React with TypeScript and Next.js for a dynamic and responsive frontend, while leveraging Firebase for backend services. Deployed and hosted on Vercel.
